_comment: The club roster, loaded by scripts/ClubRoster.gd. Yardage is CARRY (GAME_DESIGN.md Section 5). Each entry becomes a club Dictionary with name, min_yard, max_yard, type, brand, limited and ability; omitted fields default to brandless, not limited, and no ability text. `ability` is the card text; `effects` is what the rules read (see ClubAbilities.gd), so the two must agree.
_comment_starter: Bogey-Mart (Section 3A): the starting bag. Never in the draft pool.
_comment_standards: Brandless, always in the pool at standard_copies each, so every yardage gap stays covered.
_comment_brands: Branded clubs (Section 3C), keyed by brand id. Only the run's live brands enter the pool.

titanist.name: Titanist Pro Driver
titanist.ability: Buffers deviation 20% better; flies only 70% of the aim from rough

titanist.name: Titanist Blade Putter
titanist.ability: Once per round, if a putt misses, take it again with no stroke added

callowell.name: Callowell Big Deal Driver
callowell.ability: Chunk and Top played with this club hit at half severity

callowell.name: Callowell 6-Iron
callowell.ability: One of the widest irons in the game

callowell.name: Callowell Gap Wedge
callowell.ability: A Shank played with this club cannot downgrade your lie

callowell.name: Callowell Mallet Putter
callowell.ability: Putts of 10+ yds get a 20% wider band

pingwell.ability: Widened Mid tier: the middle half of the band, not the middle third

pingwell.name: Ping-Well Driver

pingwell.name: Ping-Well Gap Wedge

pingwell.name: Ping-Well Mallet Putter

macgregorian.ability: While in your bag, hazards add no bad cards to your Form deck

macgregorian.name: MacGregorian Jigger
macgregorian.ability: While in your bag, a ball on the green's fringe is putted

slazinger.name: Slazinger Power Iron

slazinger.ability: Flies 75% of the aim out of sand, not 50%

slazinger.ability: Putts of 10+ yds: 25% wider band. Under 4 yds: 20% narrower

nimbus.ability: Counts as both Wood and Iron for club riders

nimbus.name: Nimbus Driver
nimbus.ability: Counts as both Wood and Iron for club riders

nimbus.name: Nimbus Utility Wedge

_comment_limited: Limited editions: one copy each, in the pool only when their brand is live.

limited.name: Gold Cleek
limited.ability: Once per hole, create a Pure Strike. With a Titanist Wood in bag: twice per hole

limited.name: The Bulger
limited.ability: Create a Big Strike when playing a Wood from rough/bunker, once per hole. With any Wedge in bag: from any lie

limited.name: Old Tom's Niblick
limited.ability: Landing in a bunker adds a Flop Shot to your next draw. With a MacGregorian Wood: once per hole, landing on the fairway adds a Bump and Run

limited.name: The Rutter
limited.ability: Each hazard purges a bad card from your Form deck. With a Callowell Iron in bag: purges two

limited.name: Old Reliable Putter
limited.ability: Once per round, Steady Hands on a putt. With another Ping-Well club: once every six holes

limited.name: Persimmon Spoon
limited.ability: No distance penalty from rough. With a 2nd MacGregorian: plays from any lie, sand included, as though from the fairway

limited.name: The Equaliser
limited.ability: With 3+ distinct brands in your bag, counts as EVERY brand for set purposes
